decision: Danh sach cho phep song trong bang invitation da co, khong dung bang moi va khong dung mot chuoi trong appSetting
impact: Doi lai phai dat mot hang co ten cho expiresAt vi cot khong nullable ma vong nay chua co han; bu lai vong sau them link va han that ma khong phai di doi du lieu, va xoa duoc cau docs/api.md khang dinh bang ay khong dung

decision: Man Members co HAI khoi tach bach — go thanh vien la cat quyen that, rut loi cho phep chi chan nguoi chua co tai khoan
impact: Loai duong mot-danh-sach-xoa-la-cat-han (re hon cho nguoi dung nhung phai kiem danh sach o moi phien chu khong chi luc tao tai khoan) va duong chi-canh-bao-bang-chu; doi lai phai sua ensureWorkspaceMembership thoi tu them nguoi khong con duoc phep, neu khong thi nut go noi doi

decision: Tham so hd cua Google tiep tuc doc bien moi truong, o domain nha KHONG nuoi no
impact: Nhan downside co y: doi o domain nha khong doi man chon tai khoan Google. Ly do cung: googleHostedDomain() duoc goi luc dung cau hinh xac thuc o pham vi module nen khong doc co so du lieu duoc. Khong ha gi vi hd chi la goi y, cong that o hook tao nguoi dung; va giu nguyen bat bien vong hd-theo-danh-sach da ky

decision: Vong nay khong gui email, khong link de nguoi duoc moi tu bam, khong han dung cho loi cho phep
impact: Chu kho chot lam tung buoc. Doi lai nguoi quan van phai bao tin cho nguoi duoc moi bang kenh rieng cua ho; va kho chua co ha tang gui thu nen lam bay gio se keo theo mot phu thuoc ma nguoi tu dung co the khong co
revisit: vong sau, khi da co nguoi thu hai thuc su dung danh sach nay

decision: Khong xu ly chuyen dia chi Gmail co dau cham la cung mot hop thu
impact: Doi lai neu nguoi quan them nguyen.khue@gmail.com ma nguoi kia dang nhap bang nguyenkhue@gmail.com thi khong khop va ho bi chan — mot ca that se xay ra, chi la chua xay ra hom nay
revisit: lan dau co nguoi bi chan vi ly do nay

decision: bo design-pass — kho chua khai design_pass.proto_route va chua co route proto nao, nghi thuc dung o preflight theo dung luat cua no
impact: Gate 1 duyet UI bang chu — mat khoanh khac visual truoc duyet. Anh huong moi vong cham UI ve sau chu khong rieng vong nay; viec wire proto_route la viec cua kho, ngoai pham vi vong

decision: Doi hai thu tu so voi ke hoach: khoi do rut-chan-chua-vao (AC-3) chuyen tu Task 3 xuong sau Task 5, va cau tu choi giu NGUYEN cach chon theo hinh dang bien moi truong
impact: Ly do thu nhat: khoi ay doi di qua CHINH thu tuc rut that, ma thu tuc do nam o Task 5 — ke hoach xep no o Task 3 la mot vong phu thuoc. Ly do thu hai: test da ky cua vong hd-theo-danh-sach (packages/auth/test/cau-tu-choi.spec.ts) do quan he giua hinh dang ALLOWED_SIGN_IN va cau tu choi; doi cau theo nhanh moi-hay-bang se lam no bap benh theo trang thai DB. Doi lai: nguoi bi tu choi vi khong co trong bang van nhan cau goi y dung dia chi cong ty, tuc cau noi khong dung ly do ky thuat

decision: Dung o giua Task 4 va trinh nguoi hai viec: (1) thuoc doc-hong chua co rang — spyOn khong ep duoc lop doc nem loi nen dot bien  van xanh; (2) sau khi doi nguon su that cua cong vao, SAU bai kiem dang co do, trong do mot bai thuoc vong hd-theo-danh-sach DA KY
impact: Khong tu sua bai kiem cua vong da ky, vi do la doi bang chung nguoi khac da ky chu khong phai sua ma cua vong nay. Bon bai trong organization.integration.spec.ts do vi chung do dung hanh vi ma AC-5 co y lat — sua chung la trong pham vi, nhung van phai noi ra. Doi lai: vong dung giua S3 thay vi chay thang toi S4

decision: ensureWorkspaceMembership nhan duong doc qua tham so thu ba (mac dinh la decideSignInFromDb), de bai kiem tiem duoc mot duong nem loi that
impact: Ly do: db la proxy nen spyOn khong gan duoc vao db.invitation.findMany lan db.$transaction — hai lan thu deu cho thuoc XANH trong khi dot bien `catch nem lai` van song. Chi khi tiem duoc duong doc thi dot bien moi bi bat. Doi lai: chu ky ham co them mot tham so noi bo

decision: Nhanh di doi (enrolled === 0) gan nguoi dau tien lam chu bat ke vai da dinh trong loi cho phep
impact: Hop dong khong phu ca nay. Ca rat hep: workspace chua co thanh vien nao VA dong thoi da co loi cho phep vai khac. Trinh Cong 2 nhu mot muc ngoai hop dong de nguoi quyet ghi Known limits hay mo hop dong moi

decision: Khong dung duoc khung hinh cho E12 va E13 trong vong nay — ban dev cua cay dang xet bi cong khai bao day di, va nguyen nhan nam o moi truong chu khong o ma cua vong
impact: Da lam duoc: dung ca hai may chu o cong rieng cua cay nay (3300/3301), gieo ba vai, tao ba phien bang dev:session, va doc that workspace.get — no tra viewerRole va canManageMembers DUNG, tuc hai truong moi chay that. Nhung man Members van bi day sang /onboarding du API tra onboarded=true; mot API KHAC dang chay o cong 3001 va tra 401, dung cai bay CLAUDE.md canh bao. Doi lai: AC-6 va mot ve cua AC-8 khong co khung hinh, se ra UNCERTAIN o S4 va len Cong 2 cho nguoi quyet
